adcb-365-cashback.name: ADCB 365 Cashback Credit Card

perks: To be eligible for the cashback rewards, you are required to make minimum purchases of _AED_ 5,000 or more within a calendar month. You can earn a maximum monthly cashback of _AED_ 1,000 on your card.
An annual fee of _AED_ 383.25 (including VAT) will be applicable on the primary credit card from the second year onwards.
Enjoy a welcome bonus of _AED_ 365 when you sign up for the card.
The welcome bonus is a one-time reward and will be credited within 90 days in the first year of card issuance.
3% cashback on Groceries & Supermarkets spends
6% cashback on Dining spends including the online orders
5% cashback on Home Digital Entertainment subscriptions like Netflix, Amazon Prime, Disney+ and more\*
5% cashback on AI-powered subscriptions like ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini and more\*
5% cashback on Fuel & Salik spends
0.5% cashback on Select category spends
1% cashback on other Retail Spends
1% cashback on all international retail spends (excluding EU spends)

_dataIssues.eligibility: The current product offers a salary route of AED 5,000 OR eligibility for a credit limit of at least AED 3,000. Neither guarantees approval. Salary-transfer, residency and employment conditions are not fully confirmed; the previous qualification summary remains unconfirmed.
_dataIssues.earnRates: Eligible home digital entertainment and AI subscriptions are narrow categories, not a boost for all online or entertainment spending. Pay the eligible provider directly. Third-party platforms, app stores and aggregators do not qualify for the subscription rate. Salik must be paid directly or through Dubai Now. Bill payments, school fees and transactions through ADCB channels do not earn cashback, though they can count towards qualifying spend.
_dataIssues.calculation: A generic all-spend return is not estimated: direct subscription merchants, payment-channel exclusions and reduced merchant-category rates are not modelled by that example.
_dataIssues.fxFee: The displayed percentage is the issuer charge, not a guaranteed total conversion cost. ADCB’s current fee guide states that card-scheme processing is additional.
_dataIssues._features: The issuer describes benefits that have not been fully verified in this review. They are not used for automated benefit matching. Absence of a listed perk does not mean that no benefit exists; check the exact network, allowance and qualifying conditions.
_dataIssues.reviewScope: Selected primary-source fields were reviewed on 7 November 2026. The earlier source-record and scrape dates have not been advanced, and this is not a new whole-card verification. Confirm any pending costs, qualification, rewards or benefits before applying.

_dataIssues.eligibility: The current product offers a salary route of AED 5,000 OR eligibility for a credit limit of at least AED 3,000. Neither guarantees approval. Salary-transfer, residency and employment conditions are not fully confirmed; the previous qualification summary remains unconfirmed.
_dataIssues.fxFee: The displayed percentage is the issuer charge, not a guaranteed total conversion cost. ADCB’s current fee guide states that card-scheme processing is additional.
_dataIssues.earnRates: Named Shukran brands, other eligible retail, reduced UAE merchant categories and EEA merchants have distinct rates. The higher other-retail rate must not be applied to reduced categories. Rewards are credited into the Shukran membership account for redemption within the participating ecosystem.
_dataIssues.annualFeeWaiver: The product page says UAE Nationals have no annual fee, while the fee table expresses nationality concessions within relationship columns. That scope mismatch is unresolved. The resident base amount and first-year waiver are supported; do not assume the broader permanent exemption without confirmation.
_dataIssues._features: The issuer describes benefits that have not been fully verified in this review. They are not used for automated benefit matching. Absence of a listed perk does not mean that no benefit exists; check the exact network, allowance and qualifying conditions.
_dataIssues.reviewScope: Selected primary-source fields were reviewed on 7 November 2026. The earlier source-record and scrape dates have not been advanced, and this is not a new whole-card verification. Confirm any pending costs, qualification, rewards or benefits before applying.

dib-consumer-cashback.name: DIB Consumer Cashback Reward Card

annualFeeWaiver.notes: First year free under a limited-time offer. AED 210 (AED 200 + 5% VAT) annual fee applies thereafter, effective 10 May 2025 (the older Schedule of Charges lists AED 157.50).

perks: 3% cashback (each category capped monthly) on: supermarkets and hypermarkets (AED 200 cap since 10 October 2026; was AED 300), automobile servicing (AED 300), school fees (AED 200 since 10 October 2026; was AED 300), Etisalat and du bills (AED 100), fuel (AED 100), utility bills (AED 100), and Salik and Nol recharges (AED 25). Total cashback capped at AED 1,000 per billing cycle.

Cashback is earned only on those listed categories and only on UAE transactions; non-listed spend earns nothing. Since 1 December 2019, utility and government bills paid through DIB's own platforms earn no cashback.

Effective 10 May 2025, a minimum AED 3,000 of retail purchases per statement cycle is required to earn cashback, and an annual fee of AED 200 + VAT (AED 210) applies, with a limited-time first-year-free offer.
Complimentary roadside assistance up to twice a year (towing, battery boost, fuel, tyre change, lockout, off-road recovery) plus a free international driving licence.
Travel and medical cover up to USD 100,000 via Watania takaful for the cardholder, spouse and up to four children under 18, when flight tickets are booked on the card.
Sharia-compliant (Salam structure); monthly profit rate up to 3.25%.

emirates-islamic-switch-cashback.name: Emirates Islamic Switch Cashback Credit Card

annualFeeWaiver.notes: No annual fee in year one. AED 313.95 (incl. VAT) from year two, waived if eligible retail spend exceeds AED 30,000 in the prior 12 months (excludes balance transfers, cash advances, fees and quasi-cash).

emirates-islamic-switch-cashback.minPayment: 5% of the outstanding balance or AED 100, whichever is higher
emirates-islamic-switch-cashback.welcomeBonus: AED 500 cashback after AED 15,000 of retail spend within 60 days of card approval (welcome offer valid until 31 December 2026).
perks: Switchable rewards: choose Lifestyle or Travel each month in the EI+ app — you earn the accelerated rates of only the chosen category in a given month, not both.
Lifestyle mode: 8% cashback on domestic fuel (AED 100/mo cap), 4% on supermarkets, dining and education (AED 200/mo cap each), 0.5% on telecom/utilities/government, 1% on everything else.
Travel mode: 4% cashback on airlines, hotels and dining (AED 200/mo cap each), 0.5% on telecom/utilities/government, 1% on everything else.
Minimum AED 2,500 of posted spend per calendar month is required to earn any cashback; cashback expires 24 months after credit and needs a minimum AED 300 balance to redeem.

Complimentary airport lounge access at 1,200+ lounges, 2 golf rounds/month, 2 VOX or Reel buy-one-get-one cinema tickets/month, 1 valet parking and 1 airport meet-and-greet per month — each subject to a minimum monthly spend.
Multi-trip travel takaful (Sharia-compliant travel cover).
Sharia-compliant under a Murabaha structure; profit rate 3.69%/month, with no profit charged on accrued profit.

Emirates Islamic does not publish a fixed minimum salary for this card — income is assessed at application (minimum age 21). The AED 5,000 figure shown is indicative and pending primary-source confirmation.
FX fee: the Schedule of Charges lists 2.54% on foreign-currency transactions; the Key Facts Statement lists 2.34% for 'all other cards'. Treated as needs-review pending reconciliation.

welcomeBonus.rawText:
# Darna Select Visa Credit Card

##
Your key to unforgettable moments

Unlock a premium lifestyle with unmatched rewards, seamless redemption, and exclusive benefits.

Get up to 6.25% value back**

Redeem instantly across 1,200 Aldar destinations

Complimentary Darna Silver tier status

Apply now

**As Darna Points

Darna Select Visa Credit Card

Benefits

Earn & Redeem

Get your card

##
Key benefits and highlights

#### Darna Membership

Enjoy exclusive benefits and offers included with automatic Darna Silver tier status

#### Darna Points

10 Darna Points = AED 1 on redemption with your Emirates NBD Darna Visa Credit Card

#### 0% Installment Plan

0% Installment Plan at no cost across Aldar Education & Property

##
Earn & Redeem Darna Points

Get 6.25% value back as Darna Points on all spends at Aldar destinations including Yas Mall, Yas Island theme parks, hotels, spas, golf courses and other Iconic Abu Dhabi attractions.

Get 0.75% value back as Darna Points on Card spends outside Aldar destinations

Redeem Darna Points instantly at over 1,200 Aldar destinations

####
Redeeming made simple

##
10 Darna Points = AED 1 upon redemption

Steps to Redeem:

#### Step 1

Check your Darna Points balance on your Darna app or ENBD X App.

#### Step 2

welcomeBonus.rawText:
# Darna Visa Infinite Credit Card

##
Experience the extraordinary

Unlock a premium lifestyle with unmatched rewards, seamless redemption, and exclusive benefits.

Get up to 10% value back**

Redeem instantly across 1,200 Aldar destinations

Complimentary Darna Platinum tier status

Apply now

**As Darna Points

Darna Visa Infinite Credit Card

Benefits

Welcome offer

Earn & Redeem

Get your card

##
Key benefits and highlights

#### Darna Membership

Enjoy exclusive benefits and offers included with automatic Darna Platinum tier status

#### Darna Points

10 Darna Points = AED 1 on redemption with your Emirates NBD Darna Credit Card

#### 0% Installment Plan

0% Installment Plan at no cost across Aldar Education & Property

#### Golf Privileges

Complimentary access to top golf courses across the UAE

#### Roadside Assistance

Complimentary roadside assistance including recovery, towing, fuel delivery and battery boost

#### Valet Parking

Complimentary valet parking at select Abu Dhabi locations for your convenience

##### Welcome offer

#### Earn up to 15,000 Darna Points

Welcome Bonus

Earn 7,500 Darna Points on payment of joining fee

Spends Bonus

Earn 7,500 Darna Points when you spend AED 20,000 in first 3 months

##
Earn & Redeem Darna Points

Get 10% value back as Darna Points on all spends at Aldar destinations including Yas Mall, Yas Island theme parks, hotels, spas, golf courses and other iconic Abu Dhabi attractions

Get 1.5% value back as Darna Points on Card spends outside Aldar destinations

Redeem Darna Points instantly at over 1,200 Aldar destinations

####
Redeeming made simple

##
10 Darna Points = AED 1 upon redemption

Steps to Redeem:

#### Step 1

Check your Darna Points balance on your Darna app or ENBD X App.

#### Step 2

Inform the cashier that you want to redeem Darna Points. Insert your card into the POS terminal and choose between ENBD VISA and Darna Points.

#### Step 3

Select ENBD VISA for standard transactions or Darna Points for redemption of your Darna Points. For partial redemptions, split the amount into two transactions as needed.

Earn and redeem your Darna Points at participating Darna Partners

#####
Darna Platinum Membership

####
Get automatic Darna Platinum tier status

Know more

Get automatic Darna Platinum tier status

###

Enjoy a complimentary Darna Rewards by Aldar Platinum membership that brings you exclusive benefits across Aldar*:

- Dedicated parking at Yas Mall.

- Up to 40% off hotel stays and 30% off dining at Aldhafra Resort, Crowne Plaza Abu Dhabi - Yas Island, Radisson Blu Yas Island, Yas Island Rotana, Centro Yas Island, Park Inn by Radisson Abu Dhabi - Yas Island and Staybridge Suites Abu Dhabi - Yas Island.

- Discounts of up to 30% on access to Saadiyat Beach Club and Kai Beach.

- Discounts on golf sessions, padel tennis, and country clubs.

*These benefits are only a summary of the full suite of benefits offered by the Darna program and are subject to change by Darna according to their terms and conditions. Please refer to your Darna App for a comprehensive guide to your Darna tier benefits.

#####
Airport Lounge Access

####
Complimentary lounge access with Visa Airport Companion App

Know more

Complimentary lounge access with Visa Airport Companion App

###

Travel in style with the new Visa Airport Companion App.

Explore a selection of lounges across global airport destinations and enjoy privileges, latest updates and much more on the app with your Emirates NBD Visa Card.

Learn more

#####
Movie benefits

####
'Buy 1 get 1 free' on movie tickets

Know more

'Buy 1 get 1 free' on movie tickets

###

Watch the latest movies with a buy 1 get 1 free* ticket offer.

Book online on the VOX Cinemas website or app and purchase the tickets with your Credit Card to avail the discount.

*Minimum spend criteria applies.

Learn more

#####
Golf Privileges

####

welcomeBonus.rawText:
# Darna Visa Signature Credit Card

##
Your key to savouring every moment

Unlock a premium lifestyle with unmatched rewards, seamless redemption, and exclusive benefits.

Get up to 7.5% value back**

Redeem instantly across 1,200 Aldar destinations

Complimentary Darna Gold tier status

Apply now

**As Darna Points

Darna Visa Signature Credit Card

Benefits

Welcome offer

Earn & Redeem

Get your card

##
Key benefits and highlights

#### Darna Membership

Enjoy exclusive benefits and offers included with automatic Darna Gold tier status

#### Darna Points

10 Darna Points = AED 1 on redemption with your Emirates NBD Darna Credit Card

#### 0% Installment Plan

0% Installment Plan at no cost across Aldar Education & Property

#### Roadside Assistance

Complimentary roadside assistance including recovery, towing, fuel delivery and battery boost

##### Welcome offer

#### Earn 3,000 Darna Points

Spends Bonus

Earn 3,000 Darna Points when you spend AED 15,000 in first 3 months

Free for life

Free for life for a limited time only

##
Earn & Redeem Darna Points

Get 7.5% value back as Darna Points on all spends at Aldar destinations including Yas Mall, Yas Island theme parks, hotels, spas, golf courses and other iconic Abu Dhabi attractions

Get 1% value back as Darna Points on Card spends outside Aldar destinations

Redeem Darna Points instantly at over 1,200 Aldar destinations

####
Redeeming made simple

##
10 Darna Points = AED 1 upon redemption

Steps to Redeem:

#### Step 1

Check your Darna Points balance on your Darna app or ENBD X App.

#### Step 2

Inform the cashier that you want to redeem Darna Points. Insert your card into the POS terminal and choose between ENBD VISA and Darna Points.

#### Step 3

Select ENBD VISA for standard transactions or Darna Points for redemption of your Darna Points. For partial redemptions, split the amount into two transactions as needed.

Earn and redeem your Darna Points at participating Darna Partners

##### Darna Gold Membership

#### Get automatic Darna Gold tier status

Enjoy a complimentary Darna Rewards by Aldar Gold membership that brings you exclusive benefits across Aldar*:

Up to 30% off hotel stays and 20% off dining at select hotels

Discounts on golf sessions, padel tennis, and country clubs

*These benefits are only a summary of the full suite of benefits offered by the Darna program and are subject to change by Darna according to their terms and conditions. Please refer to your Darna App for a comprehensive guide to your Darna tier benefits.

#####
Airport Lounge Access

####
Complimentary lounge access with Visa Airport Companion App

Know more

Complimentary lounge access with Visa Airport Companion App

###

Travel in style with the new Visa Airport Companion App.

Explore a selection of lounges across global airport destinations and enjoy privileges, latest updates and much more on the app with your Emirates NBD Visa Card.

Learn more

#####
Movie benefits

####
'Buy 1 get 1 free' on movie tickets

Know more

'Buy 1 get 1 free' on movie tickets

###

Watch the latest movies with a buy 1 get 1 free* ticket offer.

Book online on the VOX Cinemas website or app and purchase the tickets with your Credit Card to avail the discount.

*Minimum spend criteria applies.

Learn more

####

Pay on the go with Emirates NBD Cards

Make secure, cashless payments using your compatible phone or wearable.

Know more

##### New Credit Shield Pro

#### Secure your life with enhanced benefits

0.99%

Monthly fee of your Card's outstanding balance

Up to AED 300,000

Decease cover per cardholder

AED 100

Pay out per day in case of hospitalization

Up to AED 60,000

Job loss cover for up to 12 months or until re-employment

Learn more

#### Easy installment plans

Shop to your heart's content, pay back in small amounts!

Buy electronics, jewelry, home décor, travel and entertainment tickets at participating merchants and pay it back in 3, 6, 12 or 24 months with 0% interest.

Know more

## More advantages exclusively for you

##
Requirements and documents

##

Minimum salary: AED 12,000

##

Interest rate: 3.69%

##

Annual fees: AED 315

Required Documents

- Duly filled Credit Card application

- Original Emirates ID and copy with passport copy

- Latest salary certificate for salaried individuals

- Trade license for non-individuals

- Latest 3-month original bank statements (or mini ATM statements)

- Security cheque

Credit card limit increase

- Original passport and copy with visa page

- Emirates ID and copy

- Salaried individual banking with Emirates NBD:

- Latest salary certificate (not more than 1 month old)

- Pay slip in case the salary variance is over 10%

- Non-salaried banking with Emirates NBD

- Latest salary certificate (not more than 1 month old)

- Pay slip in case of salary variance over 10%

- Latest 3 months original bank statements

- Self employed

- Valid trade license

- MOA (Memorandum of Association)

- Latest 3-month bank statement of the company (from Emirates NBD or any other bank)

Supplementary credit card application

- Emirates ID or passport of the supplementary card applicant

- Original credit card of the primary cardholder

Additional notes

Maximum eligible spends

In a given statement cycle, Miles can be earned for eligible spends up to the credit limit, or AED 100,000 for Skywards Infinite Card / AED 50,000 for Skywards Signature Card, whichever is lower. Retail spends

- Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends*

- Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends*

Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps

- Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card

International spends

Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.

Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.

Maximum eligible spends

International spends

Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.

Maximum eligible spends

In a given statement cycle, Miles can be earned for eligible spends up to the credit limit, or AED 100,000 for Skywards Infinite Card / AED 50,000 for Skywards Signature Card, whichever is lower. Miles will be awarded for eligible transactions in chronological order up to the credit limit or above stated cap, whichever is lower.

Retail spends

- Grocery and supermarkets, fast food restaurants, insurance, car dealership earn 25% of domestic spends*

- Petroleum, transit, government services, utility payments, real estate, education & telecommunications payments earn 10% of the domestic spends*

Duty free, online food delivery and car booking apps

- Domestic and international Duty free spends, domestic online food delivery and car booking apps spends earn 2 Miles per USD equivalent; spend on Skywards Infinite Card. 1.5 Miles per USD equivalent spend on Skywards Signature Card

International spends

Spends made abroad on groceries and supermarkets, insurance, car dealerships, fast food, real estate, education, petrol, government services and utility payments including telecom, earn Miles as per normal international spends.

Retail spends on merchants in the EU earn 50% of the international spends.

A nominal monthly fee of AED 250 is charged for the Express Miles programme. The listed annual fee of AED 1,500 is waived from the 2nd year onwards for cardholders enrolled into the Express Miles Programme. Bonus Miles for spends on Emirates website are excluded for Express Miles calculation.

Monthly caps per channel: online and foreign-currency cap at AED 400 each at the top tier; mobile-wallet caps at AED 200 — roughly AED 1,000 total cashback a month.
The 10% headline applies only above AED 15,000 of total monthly spend; most users sit in the 3-5% bands. Foreign-currency cashback is offset by the up-to-2.99% FX fee.
Complimentary unlimited access to 20+ local and international airport lounges via Mastercard; Cleartrip and Expedia travel discounts.

Minimum income AED 5,000; age 21-60. Finance charge differs between SC's own sources — the Service & Price Guide lists 3.69%/month (44.28% APR), the product page 3.45% — we cite the Guide figure and have flagged the discrepancy for re-verification.

wio-credit.name: Wio Credit (Mastercard World)
perks: Cashback requires a non-Standard plan: 2% on all purchases with the Salary, Plus or Family plan, capped at AED 2,500 per calendar month (the cap includes My Money current-account transactions). Standard-plan customers earn no cashback.

Paying another UAE bank's credit card through Wio Credit earns 0.5% cashback — unique in the UAE market — up to 0.5% of the Wio Credit limit, conditioned in the KFS on a minimum AED 5,000 of retail transactions in the same cycle.
Government, real-estate and utility payments (including Easy Cash) earn 0.5%, not 2%. Cash advances, quasi-cash and crypto are excluded. Cashback credits on the 1st of the following month.

The card itself is unpriced — the plan subscription is the price: Salary plan free with an AED 15,000+ monthly salary transfer (reducible for partner-company employees), Plus at AED 49/month (waived at AED 35,000 balances), Family AED 49/month, Standard AED 25/month (free at AED 3,000+ balances, but no cashback).

Roll-over interest 3.25%/month (39% APR) on Standard, Plus and Family plans, reduced to 2.29%/month (27.48% APR) on the Salary plan; interest-free up to 60 days; minimum payment 5% or AED 100; late payment AED 199.

Easy Cash: borrow up to 50% of the credit limit at AED 1/day per AED 1,000 for up to 90 days — 36.5% APR per the fee schedule's own figure. Easy Installments 3–48 months; AED 52.50 processing on the 3-month tenure, longer tenures free.
The KFS contains an income condition; see the canonical salary field and issuer eligibility terms. Application assessment does not mean that no salary requirement exists.
